mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment ( member_id, target_member_id, payment_id, order_name, currency, total_amount, pay_method, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{targetMemberId}, #{paymentId}, #{orderName}, IFNULL(#{currency}, 'KRW'), #{totalAmount}, #{payMethod}, 'READY', NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id AS memberId, target_member_id AS targetMemberId, payment_id AS paymentId, order_name AS orderName, currency, total_amount AS totalAmount, paid_amount AS paidAmount, pay_method AS payMethod, status, transaction_id AS transactionId, pg_tx_id AS pgTxId, receipt_url AS receiptUrl, fail_code AS failCode, fail_message AS failMessage, cancel_amount AS cancelAmount, cancel_reason AS cancelReason, created_at AS createdAt, paid_at AS paidAt, cancelled_at AS cancelledAt FROM payment WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
SELECT id, member_id AS memberId, payment_id AS paymentId, total_amount AS totalAmount, paid_amount AS paidAmount, status FROM payment WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET status = 'PAID', transaction_id = #{transactionId}, pg_tx_id = #{pgTxId}, receipt_url = #{receiptUrl}, paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, paid_at = COALESCE(#{paidAt}, NOW()) WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'READY'

UPDATE payment SET status = #{status}, fail_code = #{failCode}, fail_message = #{failMessage}, cancel_amount = #{cancelAmount}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, cancelled_at = IF(#{status} = 'CANCELLED', NOW(), NULL) WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'READY'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cancel_payment ( payment_id, cancellation_id, pg_cancellation_id, status, cancel_amount, reason, receipt_url, requested_at, cancelled_at ) VALUES ( #{paymentPk}, #{cancellationId}, #{pgCancellationId}, #{status}, #{cancelAmount}, #{reason}, #{receiptUrl}, NOW(), #{cancelledAt} )
